findings.message:
[P2] Skip refill projection for token-usage balances

When `balance_quota` is null, `runwayBalance` uses finite token inventory from `total_available`, but this call still runs the wallet refill projection. Because token and wallet samples share the retained history namespace, a token-mode account that previously used wallet mode can have old positive wallet deltas interpreted as token refills, producing false `sustainable` or extended exhaustion results. Skip refill-aware calculations for token-usage mode or partition history by mode.

src/quota-projection.ts:438-438

summary: The refill-aware branch is wired in, but it can apply retained wallet refill history to finite token-usage projections.

evidence: `src/quota-projection.ts:227-393` adds refill cadence, amount, sustainability, and refill-aware exhaustion calculations from balance history and refill observations.
`src/quota-projection.ts:445-452` preserves the no-refill estimate while exposing refill-aware status and dates.
`src/admin/kernel.ts:489` supplies retained balance history to the projection endpoint.
